capabilities.why: Safety hooks intercept and analyze every command prior to execution inside the guest microVM, providing an imperative pre-execution control gate to log commands, reject unauthorized privilege escalation, and block credential harvesting attempts before they reach the kernel.

Network policy enforces an egress quarantine boundary around the guest microVM, ensuring prompt injection exfiltration, command-and-control beaconing, and malicious payload staging cannot phone home even if the guest process attempts socket communication.

MicroVM snapshots capture exact CPU, memory, and filesystem disk states at critical checkpoints, enabling fast rollbacks when an intermediate agent step fails or when a suspicious package compromises environment state, eliminating costly re-provisioning loops.
